preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)
Victim wallet must hold some HODLXRP tokens to demonstrate blacklisting effect

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBlacklistEnabled(victim_address, true) to blacklist a specific wallet, or setBlacklistEnabledMultiple([victim_address], true) for multiple wallets. This will prevent the blacklisted addresses from selling tokens through the antiSnipe protection mechanism in the _transfer function.
